limitations: Truth selection is connectivity-present; no absent-truth denominator is available in this cohort.
The harness forces normalized query/library ion mode positive and charge +1; source precursor_type is not emitted as the adduct field. Raw source polarity/adduct gates are therefore not evaluated.

The truth-specific precursor audit establishes MS1 eligibility loss for a large fraction of LTQ truth records, while scored candidates that remain are predominantly below the score gate; instrument-specific fragmentation differences remain a plausible contributor but are not isolated as the sole cause.
No calibrated FDR or chemical identification validity is established.

narrow_vs_wide.interpretation: Both tolerances changed jointly; descriptive only, not causal.

source_metadata_audit.interpretation: The normalized benchmark inputs do not preserve source ion mode, charge, or precursor-type metadata; polarity/adduct eligibility in the MassFlow search therefore cannot explain these benchmark calls.

truth_precursor_eligibility_audit.mass_error_summary: absolute query minus truth-reference precursor m/z in Da
truth_precursor_eligibility_audit.tolerance_denominator: configured cosine MS1 half-window in Da
